title: Subscription Plans
description: How access, modules and pricing work today
content:
# Subscription Plans

## How pricing works
Base Point is sold as a set of modules (Duka, Pesa, Mteja, Bandu, Dala) plus add-ons (eTIMS, Asset Manager, Pesapal). Pricing depends on the modules and locations you use, so it is quoted for your business.

- Open **Discover** and choose **Contact support for pricing** on any module to get a quote.
- Some add-ons (for example eTIMS) tell you that **billing will apply** before you turn them on.

## Your plan details
Your business record shows its status (Active, Pending Approval, Suspended or Terminated), the business type and size, and the **next billing** date. Admins can see this under **Settings**.

## Changing what you pay for
- To add a module, enable it from **Discover**.
- To remove one, disable it from **Discover**.
- For plan questions, contact support through the in-app chat.

## The Billing page
The **Billing** page in the admin menu is being built. It is set to cover unified billing across all your locations, plan changes, and payment history. Until it is released, use the in-app chat for billing questions. You can ask to be notified when it is ready.

title: Payment Methods
description: Set up how your customers pay you: cash, M-Pesa, bank, Pesapal
content:
# Payment Methods

This article is about the ways **your customers pay you**. (For your own Base subscription, see *Subscription Plans*.)

## Where to configure
Open **Payment Methods** (Duka menu or admin menu). It has two parts:
- **Payment Methods**: the options cashiers see at checkout, for example Cash, M-Pesa, Card, Bank Transfer and Cheque.
- **Payment Details**: the account information printed on invoices, such as **Paybill / Business No.**, **Account No.** and bank details.

## Add a payment method
1. Open **Payment Methods** and choose to add a new method.
2. Enter the name, for example *M-Pesa*.
3. Save. It now appears on the payment screen at the POS.

Edit or delete a method from the **Actions** column. Deleting asks you to confirm.

## Add M-Pesa or bank details
Under **System Setup > Payment Methods** you can add:
- **M-Pesa payment details**: select the payment method, then enter the **Business No.** and **Account No.**.
- **Bank details**: pick a bank to auto-fill its name and paybill number, then add the account details.

These details print on invoices so customers know where to pay.

## Online payments with Pesapal
Enable **Pesapal** in **Discover** and enter your merchant **Consumer Key**, **Consumer Secret** and environment. Customers can then pay online by card or mobile money.

## M-Pesa STK Push at the POS
At checkout choose M-Pesa, enter the customer's Kenyan number (for example 0712345678) and send an **STK Push**. The customer enters their PIN on their phone and the sale completes once payment is confirmed.

title: Understanding Your Bill
description: What can affect what you pay and how to get a clear answer
content:
# Understanding Your Bill

## What drives your charges
Your charges are based on what is enabled for your business:
- The **modules** you turned on in **Discover**.
- **Add-ons** such as eTIMS and Asset Manager, which show a billing notice when you enable them.
- The size of your setup (for example number of branches), as agreed with Base.

## Checking what is active
1. Open **Discover**. Modules marked **Enabled** are the ones in use.
2. Open **Branch Management** to see how many branches you have.
3. Under **Settings**, check your business status and **Next Billing** date.

## Taxes
Pricing for your own customers (VAT on invoices and receipts) is separate. VAT is configured under **Settings > VAT Config**. See *VAT Compliance & Reporting*.

## Questions or corrections
- Use the in-app chat and describe what you expected versus what you were charged.
- Include the module or branch name so it can be checked quickly.

## Coming soon
A full **Billing** page with payment history and plan management is planned. Until then, billing support is handled through support.
